content: योगिन् {%a.%} [युज्-धिनुण्, योग-इनि वा] .²1 Connected or endowed with. .²2 Possessed of magical powers. .²3 Endowed or provided with, possessing. .²4 Practising {%Yoga%}. --{%m.%} .²1 A contemplative saint, a devotee, an ascetic; आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन . सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः . <ls>Bg. 6. 32</ls>; see the sixth adhyāya {%inter alia%}; सेवाधर्मः परमगहनो योगिनामप्यगम्यः <ls>Pt. 1. 285</ls>; बभूव योगी किल कार्तवीर्यः <ls>R. 6. 38</ls>. .²2 A magician, sorcerer. .²3 A follower of the {%Yoga%} system of philosophy. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Yājñavalkya. .²5 Of Arjuna. .²6 Of Viṣṇu. .²7 Of Śiva. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of a mixed caste. .{@-नी@} .²1 A female magician, witch, sorceress, fairy. .²2 A female devotee. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a class of female attendants on Śiva or Durgā; बलीनदात् योगिनीभ्यो दिक्पालेभ्योऽप्यनेकधा <ls>Śiva B. 6. 51</ls>; (they are usually said to be eight). .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā.
